description: This file contains unit tests for the Capsule parsing and serialization logic in the quiche project, specifically testing capsule ingestion, serialization, and handling of various capsule types including WebTransport and address-related capsules.

classes.name: CapsuleParserPeer
classes.description: Provides access to the buffered data of a CapsuleParser instance for testing.

classes.name: MockCapsuleParserVisitor
classes.description: Mock implementation of CapsuleParser::Visitor for testing capsule parsing callbacks.

classes.name: CapsuleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing capsule parsing and serialization.

methods.name: ValidateParserIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the capsule parser has no remaining buffered data and no parse failures.

methods.name: TestSerialization
methods.description: Serializes a capsule and compares the output to the expected byte sequence.
